records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Ridge Systems!
records.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for setting up Ridge Systems on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no tickets, despite three touches (email:c0f44f46, email:669c5c00, email:a3675f50). Customer's own reply (email:7cdda2b7) shows intent but explicit deferral ("busy week... dig in soon"), so some chance within 8 days, but repeated inaction and no concrete date keep it well under even.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Thanks for the reply — totally understand a busy week, no rush on my end.

When you do get a window, the smallest useful starting point is one real project: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them. If it's helpful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to sit with you while you set up that first project so it's done rather than on the list.

Best,
Chidi
